verifier.summary: Both ranks now execute production execute_model before production sample_tokens. Only model arithmetic and sampled values are fixed; real preparation computes discard masks, and production code owns pending state. A correct execution-owned pending variant prevents a return to the old idle-receiver fixture. Cached CPU-token metadata remains valid for both Base and corrected implementations.
